sources.citation: Souag, Lameen. 2010. Grammatical Contact in the Sahara: Arabic, Berber, and Songhay in Tabelbala and Siwa. PhD thesis, SOAS, University of London, 519 pp. DOI 10.25501/soas.00013430
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Kwarandzyey phonology §1.2.5 (p. 32) gives vowels, consonants, final i/u deletion and 'Kwarandzyey has lost lexical tone' but states no word-stress rule. Stress is marked only incidentally in two Kwarandzyey items: p. 338 'the Kwarandzyey word is stressed as a single word (ə@rrəg rather than Arabic ərrə@gg)' and p. 460 focus clitic '=a, usually stressed'. The stress rules on pp. 132-134 (ultimate = indefinite, penultimate = definite) concern SIWI Berber, not Korandje.
